newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-S&P upgrades structured finance ratings.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-S&P upgrades structured finance ratings.

text.p: Standard and Poor's Corp it raised the ratings of units of Westpac Banking Corp and the Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd involved in asset-backed and mortgage-backed securities.
S&P said this action followed S&P's decision to increase the long and short term ratings of the two major banks.

It said the mortgage-backed rating of ANZ unit Endeavour Mortgage Trust Fund was increased to AA minus from A plus, the same increase given to Westpac asset-backed units Mortgage Corp of New Zealand Ltd Series 3 Bonds and Mortgage Corp of New Zealand No.2 Ltd Series 3 & 4 Bonds.

S&P also said it raised the ratings of Westpac asset-backed units Sydney Capital Corp Inc's US$800 million commercial paper and Waratah Securities Australia Ltd's A$500 million commercial paper to A1 plus from A1.
